annotations.title: What sets a Spanish municipality apart, with for/against rules

description: For one municipality published on flatin.es (currently the provinces of Alicante, Málaga, Valencia, Murcia; comparisons use all of Spain): the indicators where it clearly differs from its province, Spain or its neighbours (rank, provincial median, Spanish percentile — only when at least 80% of applicable places have data), and fixed for/against rules on published data (prices, affordability in years of income, rent share of income, empty homes, crime per resident and with seasonal population, distances, fibre). Every number has its period and source. Not an opinion.
